items.label: Silent
items.text: Dialogue frequency should be Silent: Dialogue is rare. Scenes are carried by action, observation, and interiority; characters speak only when speech is the only option available. Aim for 0%-10% dialogue, 90%-100% narration.

items.label: Sparse
items.text:
Dialogue frequency should be Sparse: A few exchanged lines per conversation with narration doing the primary work between them. Aim for 20%-30% dialogue, 70% narration. 
Scene can be silent if it makes sense.

items.label: Balanced
items.text:
Dialogue frequency should be Balanced: Conversations run to natural length. 50% dialogue, 50% narration. 
Scene can be silent if it makes sense.

items.label: Often
items.text:
Dialogue frequency should be Often: Frequent dialogue, speech leads. Most scenes are built around conversation, with narration serving as connective tissue and staging between lines. 70% dialogue, 30% narration. 
Scene can be silent if it makes sense.

items.label: Talkative
items.text:
Dialogue frequency should be Talkative: Dialogue dominates. Exchanges run at length, characters speak in extended turns, and narration reduces to minimal staging. Aim for 80%-90% dialogue, 10%-20% narration.
Scene can be silent if it makes sense.
